name: Project Stats
description: Counts the files of the open projects by type: a tree, a sortable table, a chart in a tab, a status bar item and a tool for agents.

exclude.title: Skipped folders
exclude.description: Folder names never counted, one per line. Hidden folders are skipped unless Count hidden files is on.

topFiles.title: Largest files per type
topFiles.description: How many of the largest files the panel lists under each file type.

countHidden.title: Count hidden files
countHidden.description: Also count files and folders whose names start with a dot.

sortBy.title: Sort file types by
sortBy.description: count: most files first; size: most bytes first.

agentTools.name: summary
agentTools.title: Project file statistics
agentTools.description: Number of files and bytes per file type in the project, with the largest files. Use it to get a feel for an unfamiliar repository.

top.description: How many file types to list (default 15).
